name: Kumpulan Perangsang Selangor Berhad
overview: 2026年，KPS Berhad 完成两家包装相关子公司的自愿清盘：PT Infinity Packaging Solutions 启动自愿清盘，Century Packing & Printing 于4月9日正式解散。此外，公司就一项重大诉讼持续发布进展公告，并续期关联方交易授权。最新一季（2026年6月30日）营收同比下降13.9%，净利润同比增长39.1%。
overview_en: In 2026, KPS Berhad completed the voluntary winding-up of two packaging-related subsidiaries: PT Infinity Packaging Solutions commenced voluntary winding-up, and Century Packing & Printing was officially dissolved on 9 April. The company also continued to issue updates on a material litigation and renewed its shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue declined 13.9% year-on-year while net profit rose 39.1%.

segments.name: 制造
segments.note: 今年该板块涉及两家包装相关子公司的自愿清盘，其中一家已完成解散。
segments.note_en: This segment saw the voluntary winding-up of two packaging-related subsidiaries this year, one of which has been dissolved.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: PT Infinity Packaging Solutions 启动自愿清盘。
actions.text_en: PT Infinity Packaging Solutions commenced voluntary winding-up.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: Century Packing & Printing Sdn Bhd 于2026年4月9日正式解散，自愿清盘完成。
actions.text_en: Century Packing & Printing Sdn Bhd was officially dissolved on 9 April 2026, completing the voluntary winding-up.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: Century Packing & Printing Sdn Bhd 于2026年1月5日召开最终会议，以结束成员自愿清盘。
actions.text_en: Century Packing & Printing Sdn Bhd held its final meeting on 5 January 2026 to conclude its members' voluntary winding-up.
